1_research_objective.summary: This initiative aimed to create a comprehensive, data-driven mapping of the Sanskrit learning ecosystem. The project documents institutional infrastructure across central universities, global language paths, preservation methods within archives, non-formal learning spaces, and modern funding pipelines.

2_research_workflow: Step 1: Read the assignment prompt and systematically identify all 15 core research topics.
Step 2: Group interconnected topics logically into cohesive web page blueprints.
Step 3: Identify trusted public databases including the UGC register, AISHE reports, and university portals.
Step 4: Execute targeted deep-dives into official institute directories and course catalogs globally.
Step 5: Extract structured information on program depth, faculty specializations, and archiving standards.
Step 6: Cross-check extracted datasets against secondary sources and NAAC evaluation reports.
Step 7: Standardize direct URLs, institutional metadata fields, and textual citations.
Step 8: Organize data blocks into neat page-specific JSON schemas.
Step 9: Design and deploy the programmatic infrastructure of the web application.
Step 10: Compile findings into a synchronized final report and presentation deck.
3_source_types_used: Official University course registers and departmental faculty pages
Ministry of Education All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) documents
Digital libraries, catalog indexes, and manuscript archive registries
Academic journal submission guidelines and international publisher repositories
Government cultural ministries and scholarship notification portals

4_data_verification_method.primary_approach: Strict prioritization of official primary source documentation over secondary summaries.
4_data_verification_method.triangulation_protocol: Verifying university statistics by matching institutional claims with independent government registers (UGC and AISHE).
4_data_verification_method.currency_check: Ensuring program status and faculty details are validated against current 2025-26 academic records.

5_content_organization_method.structural_rationale: Dividing the portal into specific target pages ensures clean discovery and minimizes cognitive load for users.
5_content_organization_method.ui_presentation_strategy: Using consistent cards, filterable tables, and workflow maps to support side-by-side data comparisons.
